title: Prove one added paid call defeats a third frame-593 rung removal (no new κ)
body:
## Result

**Scoped negative result, finite certificate in the raw-moment relaxation. No new κ.**

[#6030](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6030) notes that removing helper 469's or 471's frame-593 rung is exclusive with #5907's and #6030's removals "unless a new carrier of that content is added". This package prices that route on #6030's published complete profile, using the raw crossing of `Σ T_r r^(1-k) − Σ P_r r^(1-k)` that this line bisects.

- Granting a free third removal with exactly #6030's per-LOCAL delta again (×18 LOCAL invocations) would move the crossing from (.00312581155791, .00312581155792) to (.00312633419236, .00312633419237), a gain of at least 5.2263e-7.
- **One added paid call of any rank 1..145 defeats that gain**, whether it is added once in the complete invoice or once per LOCAL. All 145 ranks are certified in both settings: the crossing lands below #6030's lower endpoint.
- One added rank-1 call alone moves #6030's crossing to (.00312167101310, .00312167101311). That loss is at least 7.92 times the free repeat's gain.

A carrier can therefore help only if it adds no paid call, or if it earns productive target credit itself. This package does not price those cases.

## Evidence and reproduction

`research/p104-rung-carrier-break-even/verify.py` uses only the standard library. Signs are certified with correctly rounded `Decimal` `ln`/`exp` at 60 digits and an explicit 10^-50 relative error allowance per moment. Positive controls reproduce #6030's published crossing and, with the stated delta removed once, #5907's (.00312528909884, .00312528909885). They also check the published totals: 13,444 targets, 66,834 paid calls, surplus 760. These controls test this package's pricing; they are not a review of either PR. Three damaged profiles must be rejected, and `RESULT.json` must equal the recomputation.

```sh
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B research/p104-rung-carrier-break-even/verify.py
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p104-rung-carrier-break-even
~/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p104-rung-carrier-break-even --check-source-history
```

All three pass locally on CPython 3.12. The verifier takes about 1 s.

## Limitations

- The third removal is a hypothesis. No 469/471 removal is constructed, and its real delta may differ.
- Only the raw crossing is evaluated. The tail ratios, compiler and outer checks only add conditions, so they cannot rescue an edit that fails here.
- Carriers that add productive targets are not covered.
- The profile is copied as a literal from #6030's `RESULT.json` at head `772dd10a5859a1d15f4851feb371519789213ad8` (SHA256 `84fcbe2a…1924ad`). That head is not on main, so it is not a Git pin.
- Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can a carrier for the content of sources 703/704 itself be a productive helper whose target credit offsets its paid call? Name the rank and frame, then price both deltas with this verifier before building a word.
- Does an existing paid call in #6030's word already carry 703/704 content near frame 593? That would be a zero-cost carrier. This package does not parse the word.

## Related open work

- #6030 (DreamingOfClouds): source of the profile and of the question. This package reproduces its stated crossing enclosure as a control and does not otherwise check it.
- #5907 (DreamingOfClouds): the twin removal. Its crossing enclosure is reproduced from #6030's profile minus the stated delta.
- #5994 (Matarener): exhaustion census of PR5599-type helper splits on the #5907 word. It studies a different edit class on the same word, and this package computes no number it reports.

## CI notes

At head `c7e171a9e9ee25e69b2533378abc2ada1a4fafa2`, both hosted checks passed, `plan` and `replay (research/p104-rung-carrier-break-even)`, in [run 40608040511](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/40608040511).

This account's open PRs created since the claim (#6037, #6038, #6039) study different objects and share no quantity with this package.
